statement: Vocabulary edition csharp/1: how the How's code-fact terms appear in csharp, and which csharp APIs are effects.
why: The realisation vocabulary for the csharp language target. Decisions name none of this; a decision is realisable in csharp iff every fact term it reads is mapped here.

facts.sdlc:inLayer: the MSBuild property <Layer> in the project file
facts.sdlc:dependsOn: a <ProjectReference> between two projects of the repository
facts.sdlc:inComponent: the project whose compilation contains the type
facts.sdlc:realises: the attribute [Realises("<What element IRI>")] on the type
facts.sdlc:usesApi: a member reference the compiler resolves (compiler mode) or a using of its namespace (files mode)
facts.sdlc:handlesRoute: an endpoint mapping app.MapPost(path, handler) whose handler is the type
facts.sdlc:method: the verb of the Map call
facts.sdlc:path: the route template of the Map call
